note: Prelude instance-priority ratchet. Clean's hand-rolled prelude registers typeclass instances with a GUESSED priority; real Lean serializes the true priority into every .olean (Lean.Meta.instanceExtension, one InstanceEntry per registration). Instance priority decides which candidate synthInstance reaches first -- the shape of every elaborated term. Fixed one-off three times before it was counted: 8d80c9d98 instOfNatNat (guessed 100, .olean says 1000), 066a1173f instLTNat (guessed 100, .olean says 1000; ranked 30th of 43 LT candidates), 28e7834a1 the B101 hetero bridges seeded pre-import at 50. NEVER read a priority off a Lean SOURCE attribute: instOfNatNat's 100 was read off `@[default_instance 100]`, which is a DIFFERENT TABLE (literal-type defaulting, not synthInstance candidate ordering) -- the `instance` itself is unannotated, hence Lean's default 1000. Read the u64 in the shipped .olean. baseline_mismatched is flat-or-DOWN; baseline_colliding and baseline_prelude_instances are flat-or-UP so the class cannot be 'fixed' by deleting hand-registrations until nothing is measured. known_mismatched makes a NEW mismatch fail even at a flat count. Measurement: crates/clean-olean/tests/prelude_instance_priority_census.rs; artifact: data/prelude_instance_priority_census.json; gate: scripts/check_prelude_instance_priority_ratchet.py (wired into scripts/local_gate.sh). Established 2026-08-09 against Lean v4.30.0-rc2 `import Init`.
